items.q: Can my team really edit it without breaking anything?
items.a: Yes. Each block exposes plain fields (words, images, links) and keeps the layout, fonts and colours locked to the design.

items.q: Do I need a page builder like Elementor?
items.a: No. Custom blocks replace the page builder, which keeps the site lighter and the design consistent.

items.q: Can you take over an existing WordPress site?
items.a: Often, yes. I start by mapping what is installed and what your team actually edits, then decide what to keep and what to rebuild as blocks.

items.q: Can the site be in more than one language?
items.a: Yes. I work in English, German and Polish, and plan the blocks for every language from the start.
